name: Kremlin Blocks
author: Cyberdelia
help: Turn the wheel to move a falling block. Prev rotates left, Next rotates right. Select drops instantly. Hold Play for a soft drop. Complete horizontal rows to clear them. The ghost marks your landing and the next three pieces are shown. Every ten lines raises the speed. Menu pauses. Your own music keeps playing.

achievements.name: four
achievements.title: Four at Once
achievements.text: Clear four rows with one block.

achievements.name: forty
achievements.title: Forty Lines
achievements.text: Clear forty rows in one game.

achievements.name: combo
achievements.title: Chain Reaction
achievements.text: Clear rows on five successive blocks.
